question: Which of the five source MLPs require their distributed bottom-half hidden support, and do those requirements compose additively or conditionally?

fixed_design.base_support: activation-conditioned top 50% hidden units at every site, using exactly the parent score and fit rows
fixed_design.factorial: all 32 masks; bit s changes site s from top50 to all hidden units; gain1.15; complete model patch with downstream recomputation
fixed_design.selection: among functional arms, minimize number of full sites, then worst response RSE, then integer mask
fixed_design.interaction: exact Boolean-lattice Mobius coefficients for temporal/is-was behavior and response projection
fixed_design.controls: evaluate matched controls once for the selected arm; no control outcome enters selection

predictions.pred_a_authority_replays_exactness_finit: Parent hash/terminal match; mask0 replays act50 and mask31 replays full within 1e-5; 32 unique masks; observed forwards <=60; all finite.
predictions.pred_b_a_specific_site_complement_is_mat: At least one singleton bit raises temporal behavior projection by >=.03 over mask0.
predictions.pred_c_a_parsimonious_functional_mask_ex: A functional arm exists with at most three full-support sites.
predictions.pred_d_selected_mask_is_response_and_beh: Both tasks meet response projection >=.80, RSE <=.20, and behavior projection >=.75.
predictions.pred_e_selected_mask_is_selective: Control median KL <=.02 and zero top1 flips.

terminal_policy.distributed_five_site_program: A, D, E pass but C fails
terminal_policy.conditional_hidden_support: A, B, D, E pass and higher-order interaction carries >=25% nonconstant coefficient energy
